name: Discord Server
summary: A dark chat app for a community: a rail of round server icons, a list of text and voice channels, a stream of messages in time order with avatars, and emoji reactions under each message.

philosophy.core_thesis: A community lives in a room that is always open, and the talk flows in real time instead of in threads.
design_principles: Use three columns: a rail of 72px with round server icons, a channel list of 240px, and the message stream.
Name text channels with a # and voice channels with a speaker icon.
Show each message group with a round avatar of 40px, a coloured user name, a time stamp and the text under it.
Put emoji reactions under a message as small pills with a count.
Use a dark grey ground with a blue-violet brand colour for the active items.
Give each role a colour and set the user name in that colour.
anti_patterns: Serif body text in the chat

layout.grid_mechanics: Three fixed columns (72px, 240px, fluid) and an optional member list of 240px at the right.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 25% of the screen stays empty; message groups have 16px gaps.
layout.alignment_rules: Messages align left beside the avatar; the composer sits at the bottom of the stream.
layout.container_geometry: Round server icons that turn to a 16px radius on hover; channel rows and pills with a 4px to 8px radius.

font_pairings.note: Open faces near Whitney and gg sans, the Discord faces.
A rounder open sans for a friendlier server.

hierarchy_rules: Use 12px for time stamps, 16px for messages and 20px for the server name.
Set user names at weight 500 to 600 in the role colour.
Set channel names in the muted colour, and the active one in white.

color.palette_structure: Three dark greys for the columns, white text and one blue-violet brand colour; role colours for names.
color.contrast_rules: White on the chat grey is 12:1; muted grey on the chat grey is 4.6:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat dark panels in three steps of grey.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft shadow only on menus and pop-outs.

materiality.surface_simulation: A flat dark app with soft rounded rows.
materiality.border_rules: No borders between columns; the steps of grey separate them.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; menus float with a soft shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Filled icons of 20px to 24px: a #, a speaker, a bell, a pin and a members icon.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Round server icons, custom emoji, stickers and an animated mascot on empty states.

motion.transition_physics: Server icons morph from circle to rounded square on hover; new messages appear at the bottom at once.
motion.hover_and_active: A row tints lighter grey on hover; the active server shows a white pill at the left of the rail.

emotion.target_response: The user feels present in a live room of friends, always open, with the talk moving on.

use_cases: community hubs for games and creators
chat tools for teams and classes
avoid_when: The content must be found later by search.
The audience needs a light, calm reading page.
The talk needs long, ranked answers.

modifiers.how: Turn the channel into posts with nested, voted replies.
Add large sticker images and animated emoji in the messages.

pack.why: Rounded filled icons match the channel and voice icons of the app.

ground.why: A soft dark ground in steps of grey, with no texture.

tailwind.classes: rounded bg-[#5865F2] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-[#4752C4]
